SubscriptionId.description: The ID of the Azure subscription that the Front Door belongs to

ResourceGroupName.description: The name for the Azure resource group that the Front Door belongs to

FrontDoorName.description: The name of the Front Door to purge

EndpointName.description: The name of the endpoint in Front Door to purge

TenantId.description: The value in Directory (tenant) ID on the app registration Overview

ClientId.description: The value in Application (Client) ID on the app registration Overview

ClientSecret.description: The client secret created for the app registration (AuthenticationType ClientSecret)

AuthenticationType.description: How the site authenticates with Azure

CertificatePath.description: Path to a certificate file (.pfx) (AuthenticationType Certificate)

CertificatePassword.description: Password for the certificate file, if it has one

CertificateThumbprint.description: Thumbprint of a certificate in the certificate store, used when CertificatePath is not set

Domains.description: The domains configured in Front Door that you want to purge

AuthenticationType.description: The authentication method used to access the Front Door API

ModeType.description: The purge mode to use when published
